question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution: The correct answer is **"Repugnent."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **'Repugnant.'** • The word means something that is extremely distasteful or offensive. (अत्‍यधिक अरुचिकर, बेहद नापसंद) • **Example**: *We found his suggestion absolutely **repugnant**__.* • It is pronounced as ri-puhg-nuhnt. • The word is often used in legal or formal contexts. • The correct answer is Option 1 . [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2 (Malicious)** means having or showing a desire to harm someone. (विद्वेषी, दुर्भावनाशील) • **Option 3 (Perceive)** means to become aware of something through the senses. (इंद्रियों द्वारा ग्रहण करना, देखना, जानना, बोध होना) • **Option 4 (Vacuous) **means having or showing a lack of thought or intelligence. (बुद्धि या भावनाओं की कमी; मूढ़; भावशून्य; विचारशून्य) 3a:Tdd7, The correct answer is **"well."**
